videos.description: We are SO BACK. The GFL is in session once again for our 5th year. For half a decade the Ball and Chain have provided the fantasy football world with amusement, analysis, and an enthusiasm unknown to mankind. Tune in for number 1 but make sure to stay for all 18

videos.title: Ball and Chain 2025 Finale
videos.description: Sad to see it come but glad it happened. The GFL 2025 comes to a close and it has been a wild ride. I'd like to be the first to thank you all for riding it with us.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 16 2025
videos.description: IT IS THE SEMI-FINALS but there is nothing SEMI about this episode of B&C. We dive full on into the matchups and provide you with the analysis you DESPRATLEY need for this weeks GFL matchups.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 15 2025
videos.description: THE PLAYOFFS ARE HERE! We have finally begun the GFL postseason! THIS is why we play the game, THIS is what we have been waiting for. 6 managers and only 1 title. Not to mention 50 dogs on the line for the losers locked in our losers bracket. Join the ball, the commissioner, and our punishment czar as we break down this coming week.

videos.title: Ball and Chain 14 2025
videos.description: THE BIGGEST WEEK IN GFL HISTORY IS HERE!!! 5 managers and only 3 playoff spots remain. Must win games, should win games, and impossible to win games are all ahead. However, if we have learned anything so far, it's that nothing is impossible in this great league of ours.
